overview: A medical invoicing platform for healthcare practice owners to create, manage, and digitally print professional invoices. Features two subscription tiers — Developer (admin) and User (standard) — with role-based access, invoice CRUD, PDF generation, and a developer dashboard with analytics.
features: Invoice creation with patient details, services, and amounts
PDF preview, download, and print functionality
Developer and User subscription tiers with role-based access
Invoice list with search, sort, and filter
Developer dashboard with analytics and user management
